name: – Paulo Cunha – Commission proposal
title: REPORT on the proposal for a regulation of the European Parliament and of the Council amending Regulation (EU) 2018/1806 as regards Vanuatu
part_text:
The European Parliament backs a plan to remove Vanuatu from the list of countries whose citizens can enter the EU without a visa for short stays. Vanuatu sold citizenship through investment programmes with weak security checks, so people who might pose a risk could get visa-free access. The Parliament accepts the Commission's proposal without changes. This is the first time a country has been taken off the visa-free list.

- Vanuatu's citizens will need a visa to enter the EU for short stays.
- It affects Vanuatu and anyone who bought its citizenship.
- The Parliament approved the plan; EU governments must now agree before it becomes law.
